free_tier.stated: Compte free à vie : 1 débridage offert chaque mois. Sans carte bancaire, sans essai limité. (Free account for life: 1 debrid offered each month. No card, no limited trial.)
free_tier.notes: The same page states 'Trafic illimité, sans frontières' and 'Pas de quota journalier, pas de plafond mensuel' as a promise, which the 1-per-month free counter contradicts. The counter is the specific claim and wins.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a URL or magnet is unlocked, nothing is stored by the service
per_object_cap.notes: The free tier sentence '1 débridage offert' does not state a size limit, and none is published.

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage product. The status page tracks per-host unlock success rather than stored objects.

egress.terms: Download is served by the source host at its premium speed. Premium is sold as 'Unlimited unlocking' with 'Maximum speed guaranteed'; no byte allowance is published on any page read.

interface_detail: Web console takes one link, a batch of links, a magnet or a .torrent file. No API is documented on the public pages.
tooling: Browser only on the pages read; the generated direct link can be handed to any download manager.
chaining: At EUR 2.79/month it is the cheapest monthly subscription, and its per-host success table is the only public health signal among the small providers it is a link-unlocker, not a cache, so it does not replace a torrent-cache provider.

limits_note: 70+ hosts claimed; the host page lists 1Fichier, Uploady, RapidGator, Turbobit, Mega, Ddownload, KatFile, Emload, MediaFire, Google Drive, Scribd, 4Shared, Filestore, NitroFlare, DailyUploads, Filespace, Mixdrop, FileFactory, DropGalaxy, Drop.download, UploadRar, Send.cm, Alfafile, HitFile, Prefiles, GigaPeta, FileDot, and marks Uptobox 'Hors service'.
binding_note: The free plan is one unlock a month, which is 0.14% of the pulls a 1 TiB month needs, so pull count fails first by three orders of magnitude. On Premium no byte cap is published at all, so the first failure at 1 TiB is unpublished rather than documented.

identity_cost.detail: Free account by email, explicitly 'sans carte bancaire' (no bank card). Premium is Stripe (card) or a one-time purchase; the terms say prices are in euros with VAT not applicable under article 293 B of the French General Tax Code.

reliability_note: Self-published per-host success rates run 93.1% (Mega) to 100% (Turbobit, Filespace, Mixdrop, Ddownload), which are vendor numbers and not independently sampled; Uptobox is marked out of service.
confidence_note: Prices, the free allowance and the host table are all from the vendor's own French and English pages. The success rates are a vendor claim at the reported rung. A single generated link would move the whole record to measured.

evidence.proved: Premium Monthly EUR 2.79/month auto-renewed ('-20% vs the 30-day one-time purchase'), Premium 15 Days EUR 2.49, Premium 30 Days EUR 3.49, Premium 90 Days EUR 9.99 (≈EUR 3.33/month), each 'Unlimited unlocking*'

notes: Two of its own sentences cannot both be true: 'Pas de quota journalier, pas de plafond mensuel' next to a 1-per-month free counter. The counter is the operative rule. DebridRank, a comparison site that ranks World-Debrid first with a tracked outbound link, describes it as 'the lowest entry price in this index' and 'a genuine free plan'; that site is a lead, not evidence, and its outbound links carry World-Debrid UTM parameters, so it may be vendor-operated. USD conversion at the 2026-10-23 exchangerate-api USD base. A French-market service that appeared without an archived footprint: the domain answered since 2011 but has no 2023-2025 capture at all, so this price cannot be compared with anything. The '1 unlock a month' free tier is the smallest permanent free allowance in the set and is explicitly a demo, not a working quota.
